messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "this consideration applies to patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug"
set: ["this consideration applies to patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "This also applies to patients currently taking 450 mg/day", "this applies to most brands of levothyroxine", "adjust to the minimum effective dose", "doctor may need to adjust dose accordingly", "doctor may need to adjust diabetes medications", "This applies to patients taking 300 mg/day for at least 2 weeks", "applies to people who get enough iodine in their diet", "check levels from time to time", "pain severe enough to require opioids", "Patients may be switched to the extended-release 450 mg dose", "adjust diuretic dose to minimize hypovolemia", "additional 8 weeks may be considered for patients who have not healed after the initial treatment", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
